title: Update default description template with shape-specific story variations

requirements.summary: Update BulkProductUpload component to use Default template on load and support shape-specific template selection with dynamic description updates
acceptanceCriteria: On load, the template dropdown defaults to the 'Default' template and all description fields are pre-populated with the base text
The dropdown lists at minimum: Default, Turtle, Dolphin, Frog, Whale templates
Selecting 'Dolphin' from the dropdown populates all unedited description fields with the Dolphin-specific template text
Manually edited description fields are not overwritten when the template selection changes
When auto-copy is enabled and the first item's description is the selected template text, changing the template updates all subsequent items' descriptions accordingly

file_operations.description: Fetch description templates via useGetDescriptionTemplates hook and populate the template dropdown with all available templates (Default, Turtle, Dolphin, Frog, Whale). On component mount, set the selected template to 'Default' and pre-populate all product description fields with the Default template content. When the user selects a different template from the dropdown, update all description fields that have not been manually edited with the newly selected template's content. Track manual edits per product to prevent overwriting user changes. When auto-copy is enabled and the template changes, apply the new template text to all subsequent items that were previously using the old template text.

Add useGetDescriptionTemplates hook if not already present to fetch the list of description templates from the backend via actor.getDescriptionTemplates(). Return the query result with proper loading and error states.
